body: (1) AIDA_TRACK=integration aida queue rework was refused for the integration seat on BUG-2598, STORY-2844 and BUG-2531: it needs dispatch authority (product/advisor/integrator). The advisor ruled at 00:42 against widening the seat's grant, so either product or the advisor runs the rework with AIDA_TRACK=integration, or the advisor explicitly OKs the integrator role. (2) Main regression from #4126 (BUG-2606, 5d58626): bug_2415_bwrap_session_end_ends_a_clone_pushed_by_explicit_refspec fails deterministically with !clone.exists(). Bisected: passes at 925c815, fails at 5d58626 and main f5dab5c. Comment is on BUG-2606; it needs a main-track lane. (3) p16b ff93d48 is green apart from (2). Waiting on the #4128 re-review.
subject: integration: rework needs dispatch authority; #4126 regressed main
